data.summary_en: UCoE, training-free, co-evolves executable verifier programs and agent harness state under fixed parameters, selecting candidate verifiers by driving capacity on the weakest contrast family. On six open-ended benchmarks, average preference is 59.00% (Qwen3-8B) and 57.19% (Qwen3.8-27B), 9.00 and 7.19 percentage points above matched direct generation.
